story.title: Five times AI hallucinations embarrassed governments — from South Africa's policy withdrawal to White House 'formatting errors'
story.summary: Rest of World has documented five verified cases in which AI-generated hallucinations infiltrated official government documents and policies, including South Africa's withdrawal of its national AI policy after a chatbot invented fake citations throughout the draft. Other cases include the Trump administration attributing errors in official communications to AI 'formatting problems.' The report highlights a growing global pattern of governments deploying AI tools in policymaking without adequate verification processes.
